meta.name: Wesen Craft Design DNA
meta.description: Wesen Craft UI 2.2: warm neutral operational workspace with restrained Wesen Yellow selection and near-black actions.

source_references.role: provided screenshot; visual source used for this analysis
requested primary reference; not present in the repository workspace, so not independently inspected
requested secondary reference; unavailable to web fetch, behavior/content not inferred

meta.confidence_notes: The exact neutral palette values in this refinement were explicitly selected by the user and are not measured from the reference. Reference-observed traits are separately recorded. The supplied reference screenshot includes visible user annotations; these are excluded from the design system.

color.palette_type: Neutral 90–95% with Wesen Yellow 5–10% for identity, selection, and wayfinding

primary.role: Near-black primary actions and primary text

primary_hover.role: Hover state for near-black primary actions

primary_pressed.role: Pressed state for near-black primary actions

quiet_surface.role: Quiet neutral surface and secondary hover

strong_border.role: Control boundary and stronger neutral border

white.role: Work surfaces and outlined secondary actions

semantic.success: Green only for a real successful operation or a real cost decrease, paired with a label or icon.
semantic.warning: Amber only for a real warning requiring attention, paired with text or an icon.
semantic.error: Red only for an actual error or destructive state, paired with text or an icon.
semantic.info: Wesen Yellow for actual informational status; never use yellow as success.

color.contrast_strategy: Near-black text and white primary-action labels; yellow backgrounds use near-black text. Yellow never carries ordinary text or status by color alone. Focus pairs near-black outline with yellow halo.
color.measurement_status: All exact values are user-selected design tokens, not measurements from the reference screenshot.

accent.role: Identity, selected navigation, logistics chart segment, and wayfinding

accent_muted.role: Supporting yellow border; not ordinary body text

accent_dark.role: KPI icon stroke and accessible accent detail

display.role: Upper bound for page title; no oversized landing-page display style

data.role: Currency, rates, quantity, weight, volume, and percentages

font_families.heading: System sans-serif; screenshot resembles a neutral contemporary UI grotesk, exact face indeterminate
font_families.body: System sans-serif, e.g. -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
font_families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace for IDs, codes, and aligned numeric metadata only

typography.font_style_notes: Compact, neutral sans-serif with restrained weight changes. Avoid fashion-editorial display faces in operational data views. Tabular numerals are recommended for quantities, rates, and currency; monospaced numerals optional for codes.

spacing.content_density: comfortable overall, compact inside tables and navigation
spacing.section_rhythm: Use 24–32px within related groups, 40–64px between major dashboard areas; the reference leaves a large quiet gap between manifest table and analysis panels.

layout.grid_system: 12-column desktop grid with aligned content edges; wide canvas and two-column lower analysis area
layout.max_content_width: No global application max-width. The workspace and dense tables are fluid. Cap individual components by their task; the overview is capped at 2880px on 4K and remains left aligned.
layout.columns: 12-column operational canvas. Preserve full-width dense tables; place genuinely related analysis, comparison, or context in adjacent columns on large and wide desktop.
layout.gutter: 24px between major columns; 16–20px internal panel padding; 8–12px control gaps. Reduce gutters at narrower breakpoints while maintaining table readability.

breakpoints.mobile: <=620px: compact app header and single locally scrolling navigation rail; stacked KPIs; chart below; local table scrolling; no page-level horizontal overflow.
breakpoints.tablet: 621–1199px: compact header and single nav rail; 2×2 KPIs and full-width chart; 1–2 form columns.
breakpoints.desktop: 1200–1599px: fluid work area, overview and chart side by side, 24–32px page padding.
breakpoints.large_desktop: 1600–1919px: more horizontal breathing room and wider tables.
breakpoints.wide_desktop: 1920–2559px: only active root panel visible; parallel route/quote/customs context and bounded forms.
breakpoints.ultrawide: 2560–3839px: parallel work areas, bounded forms and panels, dense full-width tables.
breakpoints.four_k: >=3840px: fluid operational canvas with component-specific caps and more simultaneous information.

layout.alignment_tendency: Strict grid alignment with fluid content width and broad calm whitespace; local asymmetry in route comparison and cost summary.
layout.table: Full-width, compact rows with sticky header and optional sticky first column. All numeric headers, values, and editors are right aligned with tabular numerals. Local horizontal scrolling is allowed below 1200px; the page itself must not overflow. Row height stays about 42–44px at wide sizes.

component_widths.form: 960–1600px according to field count; inputs remain bounded and related fields stay grouped.
component_widths.table: 100% of the available workspace; contain horizontal scrolling locally below 1200px.
component_widths.comparison: Fluid multi-column layout with readable minimum widths.
component_widths.dashboard: 12-column grid with four KPI cards in a 2×2 group beside the cost composition panel.
component_widths.search_result: Search and controls stay compact; results use available table or comparison width.

wide_screen_strategy.1280–1599: Standard desktop, 24–32px page padding; summary and chart side by side; compact operational tables.
wide_screen_strategy.1600–1919: Large desktop, wider page padding, more table capacity, and adjacent analysis when content benefits.
wide_screen_strategy.1920–2559: Wide desktop, comparison plus context and cost analysis in parallel columns.
wide_screen_strategy.2560–3839: Ultrawide, add useful context and table capacity; bound forms and supporting panels.
wide_screen_strategy.3840+: Use the operational canvas broadly. Do not center a narrow page or stretch every component; the batch overview may use up to 2880px and dense tables can fill the workspace.

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px neutral borders define cards, table rows, and controls; avoid heavy outlines except a selected option may use darker 1px border.
shape.divider_style: 1px solid #E6E6E3; table and summary separators are quiet and consistent

elevation.shadow_style: Nearly flat; soft, barely visible shadow only for floating/active controls where separation is needed
elevation.depth_cues: Surface tone and hairline borders do most separation work; do not stack multiple shadows.

iconography.style: One coherent 24×24 outline SVG family with rounded joins and ends and 1.5–1.75 optical stroke. Navigation is about 17px, operational icons 16px, KPI icons 16–18px. Neutral at rest; near-black active icons against yellow navigation selection. No emoji.
iconography.size_scale: 17px navigation; 16px operation; optical correction allowed without changing family or viewBox
iconography.preferred_set: Use the existing product icon set if established; otherwise choose a consistent outline set such as Lucide. Avoid branded/custom Maison Margiela marks.

motion.entrance_pattern: No prominent entrance animation observed; panels should appear without choreography, with optional short opacity transition for overlays.
motion.exit_pattern: Short opacity/position transition for dismissible overlays only.
motion.philosophy: Minimal and functional. Motion confirms state changes; reduced-motion preserves state and hierarchy while removing nonessential animation.

components.button_style: Primary actions use #1C1C1E fill with white label/icon; hover #343436; pressed #0E0E0F. Secondary actions use a white surface, 1px #D6D6D2 outline, near-black label, and neutral #FAFAF9 hover / #F1F1EE pressed. Import is outlined and visually subordinate to Add Item. Buttons are 36–38px high with approximately 8px radius and accessible focus, disabled, and loading states.
components.input_style: White bounded inputs with neutral border and near-black focus outline plus yellow halo. Field groups preserve reading order on wide screens.
components.card_style: Operational cards use white or very subtle neutral surfaces, 1px border, 10–12px radius, 16–20px padding, and no heavy shadow. Card surfaces are reserved for the overview and focused context; operational details prefer sections, tables, and dividers.
components.navigation_pattern: Desktop: six distinct outline icons, yellow active row, near-black icon/text, 600 weight, 3px near-black left indicator, soft-yellow hover. <=840px: compact app header and one locally scrolling horizontal rail with 44px targets and keyboard navigation.
components.modal_style: Not shown; infer a simple white dialog with neutral border, 12px radius, restrained shadow, clear title/actions and no glass blur.
components.list_style: Compact operational tables with explicit column sizing, 40–44px rows, sticky headers and a sticky first column when useful, explicit units, aligned values, and contained horizontal scrolling on narrow screens.
components.component_notes: Toolbar is a compact white strip with a fine neutral separator. FX controls pair currency, editable tabular numerals, neutral refresh action, and independent status feedback. Route cards align amounts and fee rows; actual selection uses a darker neutral border and optional small near-black dot, distinct from the neutral Reference badge. Links use #3F403D and underline on hover. Cost breakdown is a labeled list with right-aligned values and a clear total.

declaration_overview.layout: Overview heading followed by a 2×2 group of four light KPI cards on the left (58–62%) and a cost composition panel on the right (38–42%). At 768–1199px, KPI cards stay 2×2 and chart moves below. At 390px, cards stack vertically before the chart. Separate goods detail by 24–32px.

metrics.label: Total pieces
metrics.source: sumQty from current batch item quantities

metrics.label: CNY goods value
metrics.source: current declared CNY sum using existing item tax/value result

metrics.label: Weight and volume
metrics.source: selected route result context; total batch weight and CBM

metrics.label: Duty and VAT
metrics.source: existing calculateLandedCost totals when valid; existing tax summary fallback otherwise

declaration_overview.visual: Four white neutral-border cards; identical #FFF7CC icon wells and #7D6814 icons. CNY value leads; all numbers are near-black and tabular.

components.iconography: Single 24×24 rounded outline family, 1.75 optical stroke, 16–18px display. Four KPI icon wells use #FFF7CC with #7D6814 icons.
components.route_selection: Default white with neutral thin border; hover #FCFCFB and #CACAC6 border; actual selection uses #777873 border and optionally a small near-black dot. Reference badge uses #F1F1EE with #555652. These states must remain visually distinct.
components.landed_tabs: Muted default tabs; selected tab has near-black text and a 2px yellow underline.
components.exchange_controls: Refresh control has 30–32px desktop visual size, transparent or white default, neutral icon, #EEEEEB hover, #E3E3E0 pressed, and neutral dark focus ring. On touch layouts preserve an accessible hit area.

declaration_table.desktop: At >=1200px width:100%, table-layout:fixed, min-width:0; all columns visible at 1280px and 1440px without horizontal scrolling.
declaration_table.header: 11.5–12px, 550–600 weight, 1.3 line-height, #666763, one line, aligned to the body column.
declaration_table.alignment: Product name and SKU left aligned. All quantity, prices, weights, volumes, declared amounts and actions align consistently with their headers; numeric content is right aligned with tabular numerals.
declaration_table.inputs: Same family and font as surrounding cells; compact padding, transparent resting border/background, #FAFAF9 hover, white focus with #AFAFAC border and neutral focus ring. Inputs width:100%, min-width:0; product names remain in their column.

cost_composition_donut.title: Costs as a share of goods value
cost_composition_donut.logistics_cost_cny: Sum existing international, domestic, insurance, and other logistics charge totals from calculateLandedCost.totals; do not create a second freight calculation.
cost_composition_donut.tax_cost_cny: Existing duty plus VAT from calculateLandedCost.totals; do not include consumption tax in this chart measure.
cost_composition_donut.presentation: Donut: yellow logistics, charcoal tax, neutral remaining value, pale neutral track. Center is near-black. Text legend and summary show labels, amounts, one-decimal percentages, and a short derived insight.
cost_composition_donut.over_100: If total additional costs exceed goods value, the ring shows the internal logistics-versus-tax composition, the center keeps the actual percentage above 100%, and a text notice explains the condition. Do not show a fabricated remaining-value segment.
cost_composition_donut.zero_value: When goodsValueCny is zero, do not divide. Show an empty ring, an em dash, and a short instruction to enter goods value.

components.links: Near-black links with restrained accent underline; primary actions remain near-black.
components.focus_style: Visible 2px near-black outline and soft yellow halo; do not rely on color alone.
components.quote_table: All-in CNY and state lead. Selected row has a narrow yellow marker and soft-yellow tint. Each row shows Open plus a button-triggered, keyboard-accessible contextual menu for Select and Delete. Wide desktop shows list beside bounded detail.
components.customs_form: Four groups: basic information; core rates; special taxes/trade remedies; regulatory details and sources. HS Code, effective duty, and VAT lead. Empty special taxes collapse. Inputs use 1–3 columns with bounded widths.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A quiet operations desk: clearly segmented work surfaces for shipment state, route choice, and landed-cost decisions.
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary web application minimalism with a subtle premium/editorial restraint
aesthetic.genre: Operational SaaS dashboard with understated premium finish

visual_language.ornamentation: None; hierarchy uses typographic weight, neutral surface contrast, spacing, and thin rules.
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Use generous separation between workflow phases, compact spacing within tables and control groups, and deliberate page-specific composition. The canvas is fluid; do not create blank side gutters by centering a narrow page.
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Warm greige left navigation, full-width fluid workspace, compact page header, four-metric overview with a cost-composition panel, then a dense table and task-specific analysis.
visual_language.focal_strategy: Current batch value, freight/tax composition, route decision, and landed-cost action lead according to the active page.
visual_language.contrast_level: Moderate, with high contrast reserved for primary text and actions
visual_language.texture_usage: No visible texture; flat matte surfaces

composition.hierarchy_method: Typographic hierarchy, spacing, hairline separators, near-black primary actions, and neutral interaction cues.
composition.flow_direction: Page header to task-specific overview/workspace; comparisons and cost context move alongside their related content at wide sizes; dense records use the available width.
composition.grouping_strategy: Thin borders and whitespace group related records; section headings sit outside and above their panels.
composition.negative_space_role: Separates workflow phases and protects scanability. Preserve broad whitespace around task groups while keeping table rows dense enough for operations.

imagery.photo_treatment: No photography shown; product imagery is unnecessary for primary logistics workflows
imagery.illustration_style: No illustration shown; use simple diagrams only when they clarify a route or shipment state
imagery.graphic_elements: Outline utility icons, selected-route dot, simple status badges, rules and data tables
imagery.image_shape: Not applicable; any shipment/product thumbnails should be optional, small, and subordinate

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate and restrained; navigation and actual selected states use neutral grey surfaces and near-black text. Success, warning, and error colors appear only for actual semantic status.
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Use subtle neutral surface changes and a clearly visible neutral dark focus indication; avoid lift, glow, or scale effects.
interaction_feel.loading_style: Not observable; use quiet skeleton rows or inline progress that preserves layout

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Direct imperative with specific action labels
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain what data is missing and provide one next action; keep the same quiet surface style
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Specific, calm, actionable, and tied to the affected calculation or shipment

overview.fallback_strategy: No advanced effects required; standard controls remain fully usable with reduced motion and without animation.

background_effects.description: Flat solid off-white/white surfaces; no gradient, noise, or animated background visible.

particle_systems.description: No particle effects visible or needed.

shader_effects.description: No shader or distortion effects observed.

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll-linked morphing visible or indicated.

text_effects.description: Static crisp typography; no animated, gradient, or distorted text.

cursor_effects.description: Use standard platform cursor and accessible focus states.

image_effects.description: No image treatments or hover transforms are shown.

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas-rendered content; use ordinary charts/maps only if logistics tasks require them.

params.color_scheme: neutral surfaces with locally applied neutral interaction cues

svg_animations.description: No animated SVG effects visible; utility icons may be static SVGs.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Use flat white and warm greige surfaces, fine borders, restrained radii, near-black primary actions, and neutral grey interaction states only. No blur, glass, gradients, decorative motion, or 3D is needed.

anti_patterns: No excessive pill shapes; reserve pills for compact status indicators when useful.
No oversized SaaS headings or landing-page display typography.
No decorative charts without an operational decision purpose.
No excessive animation or motion that competes with data.
Do not reproduce bright-yellow boxes or red handwritten numbers from reference screenshots; they are user annotations, not interface elements.
No yellow primary actions or broad yellow card surfaces; a restrained yellow active navigation row is required.
No decorative success/warning/error colors; semantic colors communicate actual state only.
No global narrow max-width that leaves wide operational screens unused.
No eight-metric 4×2 batch overview; use the four-metric overview and real cost composition.
No fabricated remaining segment when the additional-cost ratio exceeds 100%.

reference_observed.source: Supplied dashboard screenshot. The screenshot includes handwritten and boxed user annotations in the supplied capture; those annotations are not interface design and must not be reproduced. Reference observations are descriptive only and do not override Wesen-specific selected interaction rules.
observed: Warm greige left sidebar beside white work surfaces.
Near-black typography and filled black primary actions.
Compact horizontal toolbar with a subtle bottom separator.
Thin 1px-like neutral panel and row separators; restrained corner rounding.
Compact table with aligned numeric and currency values.
Broad whitespace between table and lower analysis panels.
Route comparison beside a cost breakdown.
A small number of high-contrast inline action links are visible; Wesen renders routine links in neutral dark grey.
Flat low-noise surfaces with little visible elevation.
not_observable: Exact source CSS dimensions, font family, and exact token values.
Hover, focus, transition, loading, and responsive behaviors from the static screenshot.

color_measurement.reason: The named reference image is absent at design/references/variant-dashboard.png, and the available deterministic script cannot run because its sharp dependency is not installed.
color_measurement.palette_status: The neutral palette values in this refinement are explicitly user-selected, not screenshot measurements. Earlier screenshot palette observations remain approximate and unverified.

reference_observed.dimension_confidence: Proportions and component measurements in the earlier profile are estimates from the displayed screenshot, not recovered source specifications.

wesen_adaptations.classification: Wesen-specific requirements and implementation rules selected for this logistics and landed-cost application; not claims about the reference screenshot.
rules: Preserve Wesen identity, established terminology, workflow behavior, calculations, data schema, persistence, and APIs.
Use a fluid app shell with no global max-width; cap forms and supporting panels at component level.
Use warm greige, white, near-black, neutral grey, and restrained Wesen Yellow at roughly 5–10% of visual attention.
Use compact wide tables with numeric values aligned right and tabular numerals.
Use the existing calculated landed-cost totals to display logistics, duty, VAT, and cost ratios.
Use page-specific compositions for declaration, route comparison, freight quotes, landed cost, customs, and lookup.
Preserve Chinese, Japanese, and English, keyboard access, WCAG AA contrast, responsive behavior, and reduced-motion preferences.

preserve: Warm greige sidebar, white work surfaces, near-black typography and primary actions, thin neutral separators, restrained radius, compact tables, and low shadow.
Use Wesen Yellow for identity, active navigation surfaces, selected tabs, focus halo, and logistics chart data.
Keep semantic green, amber, and red for real success, warning, and error states; pair color with a label or icon.
Keep primary actions near-black. Selected navigation uses a restrained filled yellow row with a near-black indicator and near-black text.
Avoid gradients, glass, heavy shadows, decorative charts, broad color washes, and card-inside-card stacks.
adapt: Use a fluid workspace without a global 1440/1520px cap. Let dense tables use the available width.
At 1280–1599px use a compact desktop workspace; at 1600–1919px use more table capacity and adjacent analysis when useful.
At 1920–2559px place genuinely related comparison and cost/context panels side by side; at 2560px and above add parallel information while bounding forms and inputs.
At 4K keep the overview at or below 2880px and left aligned, while tables may fill the workspace.
Replace the old eight-metric overview with four KPIs: total pieces, CNY goods value, total weight/volume, and duty plus VAT; show the cost donut and text summary alongside.
Use existing calculateLandedCost totals for logistics and tax summary. Never alter freight/tax formulas or invent values.
At tablet, use 2×2 KPIs with chart below; at mobile, stack the four KPI cards before the chart; contain table scrolling locally.
Keep all values and states accessible by label, keyboard focus, and non-color cues.
avoid: Do not use yellow as a primary button fill, page background, sidebar background, or broad card wash.
Do not use yellow to represent success; do not use semantic colors decoratively.
Do not show a fabricated remaining goods-value segment when additional costs exceed 100%.
Do not divide by zero or display NaN or Infinity in the donut.
Do not cap every page at 1440/1520px, center a narrow content column on 4K, or stretch inputs and cards without a task reason.
Do not change calculations, customs/tax rules, FX logic, freight logic, schema, persistence, import/export, or APIs.

ui22.stylesheet: src/ui/ui21.css owns base, component, token, and responsive rules; index.html has no inline style
ui22.panel_visibility: Only .panel.on is visible; wide root grid uses #routes.panel.on
ui22.route_fcl: FCL editor and confirmed quote comparison belong solely to the routes panel; editor can be collapsed
ui22.legacy_data: v3 batch tracking and trackings fields remain opaque and inert; new and duplicated batches omit them
ui22.preserved_logic: Product, FX, duty, VAT, LCL/FCL, quote, customs, allocation, landed-cost, import/export, and persistence calculations remain unchanged
